finding: Pinned BAM reads current qpos/qvel and retained qfrc_bias, qfrc_constraint, efc_force and qfrc_actuator to update motor torque/friction. The latter are outputs of the preceding solver step. No extra mj_forward is inserted in V64.
boundary: Source/pipeline inference: command and BAM update periods remain fixed, but integration subdivision also changes the age of retained solver fields read by BAM. V64 does not separately record controller-input generalized-force vectors, so their contribution is unisolated. The experiment measures coupled integration/BAM response, not solver error alone.
